description: One packet for one entity at a date (as_of): the entity as we held it then, the pins held by then, its relationships valid then, and the satellite still for that date. Charged for the parts delivered. Agent keys only. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

as_of.description: The date of the packet, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. Required.

max_cloud.description: Maximum cloud cover of a scene, 0-100 percent. For the still. Default 20.

radius_km.description: Radius for the nearby pins, in km. Default 25.

name: entity_state
